name: 95531 · Crescent City, CA
findings: ZIP 95531 (Crescent City) has 73 nonprofit organizations. 30 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95531 (Crescent City) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 95531 (Crescent City) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.
